review_description: Highly professional installation. High quality products. Expansive and thorough explanation of products capacity and digital support.

I couldn’t have been more pleased with the EV charger installation service! From start to finish, the process was seamless and professional. Michael arrived on time, assessed my needs, and provided expert advice on the best location for the charger. He was incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to explain the installation process and answer any of my questions.His workmanship was faultless, and he ensured that everything was done to the highest standard. I also appreciated how clean and organized he was, leaving the area spotless after completing the job.His pricing was very competitive and I can highly recommend his services to anyone looking to install an EV charger. Truly a 5-star experience!Even after the job was completed and money was exchanged, Michael took the time to follow up with me and ensure that everything was working as required, a rare site with modern day tradies!

The job was straightforward forward and it was a good-quality install. I am very happy with the result and it has reduced our power bills a lot. I would recommend Rapid AMP to anyone looking to get some electrical work done or a solar install.

We contacted Rapidamp to design a solar system to meet our needs for our new property at Little Hartley.We found Michael easy to deal with and very informative as we went through the many options and systems available. After discussing our budget Michael designed a 15 kw system driven by 2 x Sungrow inverters. One 10kW in the house and the other 5kw hybrid inverter in the garage for battery and car charging upgrade in the future. The panels were mounted and spread across North and west and mounted at the ideal 35 degree pitch.The entire process went smooth and it was a pleasure to see such great workmanship with an eye for detail and the final result. Michael arranged connection to the grid and we were running. The site was always left clean and tidy to finish.Wow. The system works great. The app is easy to use very informative as to what’s being used and generated etc etc.Michael already showing good backup service answering my various questions.What a great system we have and a great installer we chose. No fuss, great service and price.Highly recommended.

Michael recently installed some solar panels for us. From start to finish he delivered work of exceptional quality. Michael is an excellent communicator, kept us in the loop throughout the process, including the planning, design and installation. There is not enough adjectives to describe his attention to detail and cleanliness. Michael assisted with the grid connection and even followed up after the installation process to ensure that everything was going as planned. I can highly recommend him for any of your electrical projects.
